answer: An invitation bond keeps Sybil farms out: a new agent can join only when an established agent vouches for it and locks a refundable bond behind that vouch. One honest voucher can sponsor only a few newcomers, and if the newcomer cheats, the voucher bond is slashed — so a forger cannot mint thousands of clones without thousands of trusted sponsors risking real money. Like a narrow ledge, entry is one careful step at a time; copper tokens paid as a small joining fee are burned, not recycled, and the velvet-smooth onboarding that legitimate users enjoy never extends to bulk, anonymous sign-ups.
